pairs.summary: ZFP42 and ZNF417 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 3 of 14 profiles analysed (HT-29 colorectal adenocarcinoma; K562 chronic myelogenous leukemia; Zhang2021 hepatic tissue | Fibroblast (Liver Adrenal)). Median lift 1.51x, typical spacing ~59 bp between sites. In 3 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction. Evidence: motif co-occurrence only (ChromBPNet not yet run for this pair).
